name: Detritus Form
body:
School transmutation (polymorph); Level adept 3, druid 3, shaman 3, ranger 2, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components S

EFFECT

Range personal
Target self
Duration 10 minutes/level (D)

Your form collapses to mirror your natural surroundings. The caster transforms into a pile of fallen leaves, branches, or other natural refuse and gains a bonus on Stealth checks in natural terrain equal to half their caster level. All objects worn and carried by the caster up to a medium load meld into this new form.

DESCRIPTION

The caster maintains their base land speed and any other movement they possess that does not rely on their physiology. This transformation prevents the caster from speaking or casting spells that require somatic components though they may provide any material component that was on their person at the time of transformation. While transformed they take half damage from all sources other than fire and may squeeze through spaces as though they were tiny sized.
